title: Jagged Korean Duck Stir-fry
description: A quick, shattering Korean dish featuring duck-confit legs, mild gochujang, and fresh scallions.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 teaspoon of sesame oil and let it warm.
Toss in minced garlic and grated ginger, sauté until aromatic ~1 minute.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of gochujang and 1 tablespoon soy sauce, cook for 30 seconds.
Add sliced scallions, cook for another minute until slightly softened.
Place the pre-cooked duck leg pieces into the skillet, breaking up any clumps.
Pour 1 tablespoon rice vinegar, stir, cooking until duck is evenly coated and heated through ~3-4 minutes.
Sprinkle with a pinch of white pepper and toss with toasted sesame seeds.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and let the flavors meld for 2 minutes.
